name: abacova
description: Ask about your abacova finances from ChatGPT: accounts, transactions, budgets, reports and debts.

interface.longDescription:
abacova is a money tracker for individuals and small organizations. Connect it and ask about your own finances in plain language: your balances and net worth, what you spent by category and month, how your budgets are doing, who owes you money, what is coming up, and any report you have saved in abacova. Answers use your real figures.

The connection is read-only unless you turn on Allow changes when you connect. With it on, ChatGPT can also re-categorize and tag transactions, create transactions, tidy up categories and tags, and create or edit your auto-categorization rules. Every change is recorded in your abacova audit log, and you can disconnect at any time in Settings → Integrations.

Requires an abacova account.
defaultPrompt: Using abacova, how much did I spend by category last month?
Using abacova, how are my budgets doing this month?
Using abacova, what is my net worth today?

positive.prompt: Using abacova, what is my net worth today?
positive.expected_behavior: One total in the display currency, plus the split by account type.

positive.description: Spending by category for last month
positive.prompt: Using abacova, how much did I spend by category last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Categories ranked by spending for last calendar month, with the total.

positive.prompt: Using abacova, show my 10 most recent transactions.
positive.expected_behavior: Ten rows, newest first, with date, description, amount and category.

positive.description: Budget status for the current month
positive.prompt: Using abacova, how are my budgets doing this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Each active budget with spent vs limit and what is left.

positive.prompt: Using abacova, who owes me money?
positive.expected_behavior: People with an open balance in your favour and the amounts.

negative.description: Money transfer request. No tool moves money: the assistant says abacova records finances and cannot make payments or transfers.
negative.prompt: Using abacova, send 100 euros from my checking account to Ana.

negative.description: Unrelated question. abacova is not called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Madrid tomorrow?

negative.description: Delete request on a connection made WITHOUT Allow changes. delete_category is not offered on a read-only connection; the assistant says changes need Allow changes (set when connecting, or in Settings → Integrations in abacova) and nothing is deleted.
negative.prompt: Using abacova, delete the category Restaurants.

publication.release_notes: First release: read your abacova accounts, transactions, budgets, debts and reports; optional changes (categorizing, tags, rules) when you allow them.
